title: Good app
body: I love the fact this app respect your privacy and let you used it with out register or login. Easy to use and very pleasant. I would to ask for a feature... I am color blind and even doing the right adjustment to the iPhone colour filter I am not able to see differences between the color for completed or not activities. Will be nice to be able to choose the color. Having other default color will also helps. Other other that it is a wonderful app and the one you will use to improve you in the way you wish. Thank you.
author: leo.dr
